_source: Programme-level learning outcomes derived from the Imperial College London BEng/MEng Computing and Joint Mathematics & Computing programme specifications and the Engineering Council AHEP4 accreditation learning outcomes (which these degrees are accredited against). Used as the interim's third node type ('Learning Outcomes') for the 'which programme-level outcomes a course fulfils' mapping.

beng_computing.title: Mathematical & computational foundations
beng_computing.description: Apply knowledge of mathematics, discrete structures, algorithms and the theory of computation to model and solve computing problems.

beng_computing.title: Programming & software construction
beng_computing.description: Design, implement, test and debug correct and efficient software across multiple programming paradigms and languages.

beng_computing.title: Computer systems & architecture
beng_computing.description: Explain the design and operation of computer systems, processor architecture, operating systems and computer networks.

beng_computing.title: Data & information management
beng_computing.description: Model, store, query and reason about data using databases, information systems and data-management techniques.

beng_computing.title: Artificial intelligence & machine learning
beng_computing.description: Apply machine learning, artificial intelligence and statistical data-analysis techniques to real-world problems.

beng_computing.title: Software engineering & teamwork
beng_computing.description: Apply software-engineering methods, processes and tools, and work effectively in teams to deliver substantial software systems.

beng_computing.title: Theory & formal reasoning
beng_computing.description: Apply logic, formal methods and mathematical reasoning to specify, analyse and verify computing artefacts.

beng_computing.title: Security, privacy & professional ethics
beng_computing.description: Analyse the security, privacy, legal, social, environmental and ethical implications of computing systems and act professionally.

beng_computing.title: Human-centred computing
beng_computing.description: Design, build and evaluate interactive systems, graphics and visualisations that meet the needs of human users.

beng_computing.title: Independent investigation & communication
beng_computing.description: Conduct independent investigation, critically evaluate evidence, and communicate technical findings to varied audiences.
